messages:
oliver: Quick heads-up  I'm opening a tiny PR to switch a few tool-calling examples to the 'envelope' structured-output shape. PR #4281. Need docs + SDK snippets updated.

rachel: Which examples?

oliver: order-cancel flow, calendar-invite, and the embeddings rerank sample.

sam: I'll take calendar. Which file?

oliver: docs/examples/flows/calendar-invite.md. Also update docs/guides/tool-calling.md to point at the new sample.

kevin: For SDKs I'll add safeParse helpers (js/py) showing a regex fallback and then validate against the JSON Schema. Short snippet in the examples folder.

maria: Embeddings sample is duplicated in two pages; I'll update both and add a redirect for the old anchor.

rachel: Remember docs style: include before/after fenced blocks in the PR description for each snippet. docs-bot will block missing diffs.

oliver: noted. Example envelope we will show: {"envelope": {"result": {...}, "meta": {...}}} — will include full schema under docs/schemas/structured-output.json.

kevin: I'll add tiny AJV-based test in docs-tests that loads the example output and ensures schema passes. Keeps regressions out of main branch.

sam: Legal note: the embeddings snippet borrowed from an external gist; I'll add attribution and ping legal.

maria: I'll open the redirect PR after this merges and link it in #4281.

rachel: Also add a one-line migration note in docs/migration/tool-calls.md explaining the envelope and a compatibility tip for older consumers. Keep it under 4 lines.

oliver: Added checklist in the PR description: (1) schema file; (2) examples updated; (3) SDK helpers; (4) tests; (5) redirects; (6) legal attribution. Assigning reviewers.

docs-bot: Deploy preview for PR #4281 available at https://deploy-preview-4281--docs.redwood.ai/tooling/structured-output (expires in 24h).

kevin: I'll draft the JS helper and push it to the PR branch.

sam: Ping me when calendar PR is ready for review.

oliver: Will do in ~15m. Thanks all :thumbsup:

rachel: Thanks, team.
